caption: The video captures a calm lake at sunrise, seen from a wooden dock. A white boat with a red center stripe and dark windshield is moored along the left edge of the dock, while a rope extends from the dock's right side off-frame. The far shore is lined with coniferous trees, and the low sun creates a golden glare on the left horizon. A horizontal band of mist hovers over the water, with wisps rising among the trees and reflecting in the surface. Throughout, mist slowly drifts and reshapes, changing density and outline across the lake. The golden-lit fog on the left and the central band shift subtly, while haze above the trees moves in faint layers. The boat, dock, rope, tree line, sun position, and dock shadow remain fixed in place. The water surface stays smooth, preserving reflections of the trees. No translation or deformation is visible in the solid objects. The scene remains a quiet, ongoing process.
